name: YOKAI HUNTERS
detailed_description:
Yokai Hunt in Feudal Japan

Step into the dark world of feudal Japan, where ancient evil lurks in the shadows. Join a team of yokai hunters as you explore cursed villages, abandoned temples, sinister catacombs, and forgotten fortresses to banish the supernatural.

Cooperative Horror Gameplay

Form a team and choose your class — each hunter possesses unique abilities vital for survival. Strategy and teamwork are key to victory. In these cursed lands, no one survives alone.

Class System with Unique Abilities

Choose your role: samurai, kunoichi, monk, or priestess. Each class comes with distinct powers. Work together with your team to make the most of your strengths and overcome the horrors dwelling in these haunted lands.

Ancient Rituals and Magic

To defeat the yokai, brute strength won’t be enough. Collect sacred artifacts, perform dangerous rituals, and harness magical powers to drive out the evil. Every action could be your last.

Dynamic Battles with Unique Enemies

Every yokai is more than just a monster—they are distinct threats with their own behaviors and weaknesses. Study their patterns and find their vulnerabilities, or you won’t live to tell the tale.

Replayability and Changing Locations

Each playthrough tells a new story. Locations are procedurally generated, and enemies and artifacts change every time. Every hunt is unique, and you can never fully prepare for what’s to come. The darker it gets, the more dangerous it becomes. Work together, gather sacred relics, fulfill your objectives, and escape while you still can. And remember — not everyone can be saved.

Tense Atmosphere and Grim Storytelling

Explore eerie, abandoned locations filled with secrets and dangers, where every step brings you closer to uncovering the ancient evil. Many have tried to stop the darkness — few have returned.

short_description: You are yokai hunters venturing into cursed lands from which no one returns. Assemble your team, choose your class, and attempt to banish ancient evil in dark feudal Japan. Survive — or become part of the legend.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of horror, violence, and disturbing imagery. Players may encounter supernatural entities, intense chase sequences, ritualistic themes, and graphic deaths. Some content may be frightening or triggering to sensitive players. There are no sexual themes or substance abuse depicted.
